description: Assemblymember Chris Rogers was born and raised on California’s North Coast, where he’s spent his life working to make the region more livable, resilient, and equitable. From the redwoods of Del Norte to the rolling hills of Sonoma County, Chris understands the challenges our rural and coastal communities face—and the opportunities that come when local voices are heard in Sacramento.
